Was hoping these would make the re-usable pod cleanup easier... which it does.  BUT, it seems the material is too thick and the liquid is forced back up through the top of the reusable pod, forcing grounds out and into the cup, even using the strong brew setting.  Tried poking holes with a toothpick to increase flow, but gave up on these, and just using the pod without a filter liner and dealing with it.  We keep a mug on the counter that we tap the grounds into from the filter, then do a quick rinse.... easy enough.

Freezer is warmer than I like, but holding and making ice. When freezer gave up completely, defrost heater failure detected, part ordered, arrived next day, installed, and working. No need to hurry to buy a new frig.

NOTE: I only used the heater portion of this kit; not either of the other accessories.

My GE side-by-side had stopped cooling properly. The freezer was up around 30⁰ with the fridge around 40⁰. Should be 0⁰/35⁰ per my settings. A quick search told me to check the back wall of the freezer for ice build-up, and boy, was there! I considered calling a repairman but figured I'd first try my hand at the repair based on what I'd read. Dismantling all the shelves & back wall is a pain, but once I had access to the part, the swap-out was a snap. Ending of the story? No more back-wall frost, and I'm back to 0⁰/35⁰. The repair has been reliable and stable for the last two months or so since I did the work.

Defrost timer (switch) was rated to open at 140 degrees instead of 130 like original. I reinstalled the original.

Thermistor read around 10k ohms at room temperature. Freezer compartment thought that 41 degrees was good! Put back in the original thermistor and all is well.

Bought this element in January and it failed in less than 2 months. I am a professional repair man, installed many hundreds of elements and never had a recall in 2 or more years. Never in only 2 months. I find this a large problem with the product. The supplied defrost termination switch was changed at the same time and still is in working order.
